title: Jawa 42 Bobber Black Mirror (Circuit Spec)
description: Representing Jawa Motorcycles's prowess in the Middleweight Sportbike class, the Jawa Motorcycles Jawa 42 Bobber Black Mirror (Circuit Spec) is delivers authentic heritage styling paired with modern highway mile-munching comfort. Its tuned powertrain delivers immediate, tractable torque against a curb weight of 108 kg, ensuring responsive roll-on acceleration in demanding road conditions. With a balanced 820mm seat height providing confident footing and natural knee comfort and a comfortable Aggressive Forward Tuck layout, it offers fatigue-free ergonomics whether carving traffic or cruising the open highway.
